title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache and deps hygiene
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Our GitHub Actions surface has grown organically and duplicated work across repos and workflows which increases CI minutes, slows PR feedback, and makes maintenance error-prone. This PR consolidates lint/test/release workflows into a smaller set of opinionated, cache-aware workflows, centralizes reusable logic into action composites, and applies dependency hygiene (bump GH Actions, pin major versions, remove deprecated steps). Goals: 1) Reduce total CI runtime by sharing caches and reusing matrices where possible. 2) Improve reliability by standardizing environment setup and cache keys. 3) Make release automation deterministic and safer with a dry-run gating step. What I changed (high level): - Consolidated .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/format-check.yml into .github/workflows/lint-test.yml that runs formatting, eslint, and unit lint in a single job with job outputs for downstream gating. - Merged test jobs into a single matrix-managed workflow .github/workflows/test-suite.yml with staged caching (install -> cache node_modules and yarn cache -> test). - Reworked release automation into .github/workflows/release.yml with an explicit dry-run job that must pass before the actual publish job runs; added release-notes validation. - Added .github/actions/cache-warmup composite action to populate actions/cache quickly and reduce cold-cache penalties across jobs. - Standardized cache keys to include repo and node-version and a short hash of lockfile to avoid unnecessary cache churn. - Upgraded GH Actions used (actions/checkout@v4 -> v4 pinned, actions/setup-node@v4 pinned, actions/cache@v4 pinned) and removed legacy third-party actions flagged by security scans. - Cleaned up repo-level CI docs (docs/ci.md) with the new workflow diagrams and troubleshooting section. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and remove duplicates - [x] Add cache warming composite action - [x] Pin GH actions and bump versions - [x] Add release dry-run gating - [x] Update docs and troubleshooting - [x] Run CI and observe stable passing in canary repos Rollout plan: merged to main after approvals, monitored CI for 48h and rolled back a minor change to cache key after a flaky cache miss on node 20. Related: ENG-2345 for infra consolidation, INF-987 for release automation reliability. Notes: kept the lint+test consolidation opt-in for repos that require separate runners (added repository-level opt-out via workflow_dispatch label), left release automation intact for private repos (guarded by a repo feature flag).
commits: feat(ci): consolidate lint and format checks into single workflow (lint-test.yml)
chore(ci): add composite action cache-warmup and reuse across jobs
refactor(ci): standardize cache keys and bump GH Actions to v4
feat(release): add dry-run gating and release-notes validation
docs(ci): update CI troubleshooting and workflow diagrams

backcompat: no runtime code changes; opt-out flag available for repos that need prior behavior
